assessments.reasoning: The pinned Index scope includes relevant data and defines license by an identifiable grant and edition. The v2 grant and its definition of Information meet both requirements.

The Archives’ nationalarchives.gov.uk/doc/open-government-licence/version/2/ endpoint returned the scoped English HTML digest. Bytes [8250,8300) declare version 2.0. The About section attributes development to the Controller of HMSO and explains its public-sector licensing purpose. The compatibility and guidance passages supply context only.

The pinned Index decision, bytes [4602,4805), binds 990ddf134613455bab18f518e86f8d68, Open Government Licence v2.0 (UK), ogl-uk-2-0, sha256:f43b76732008f9cf9b51d6a8dc45db23289b784e79691e0de04cc08c51f6d9be, license and active.

challenge.method: Compared the UK v2 and v1 HTML bodies and tested the Canada v2.0 and UK v3.0 decision rows as alternative identifications.
challenge.results: The UK v2 witness expressly declares version 2.0 and links separately to version 1 and the latest edition. The Canada v2 and UK v3 rows carry different entities and digests. Shared titles, version numbers or active values cannot substitute for the UK v2 witness.

limitations: The HTML uses “His Majesty’s Stationery Office.” The candidate records different monarch wording in the pinned SPDX text. The listed originals permit direct verification of the publisher wording only.

The grant requires information expressly offered under the license and excludes, among other things, personal data and unauthorized third-party rights. Work-specific applicability, redistribution and installation need separate evidence.
Active describes Index maintenance. The publisher’s latest-version link, SPDX status and consumer release authorization answer separate questions.
reasoning: The National Archives identifies version 2.0 in both the edition declaration and suggested attribution. The grant covers expressly offered information protected by copyright or database right. The Index admits this kind of data license and assigns active to the exact UK v2.0 HTML revision.
